notes: Cash (modified cash) basis school district; entirely governmental funds (School Nutrition is in governmental funds), business_type null. Trimmed PDF has 20 pages and does NOT include the revenue half of the governmental funds statement (printed p7) or the first half of disbursements, so receipts/disbursements were taken from the Statement of Activities (pp1-2): program receipts (charges, operating grants) plus general receipts, excluding 'Other nonrevenue receipts' 1,370,230 which is recorded as other_financing (printed as Other in the Total Governmental Funds column, p4). Total receipts 35,490,525 computed (disbursements 32,383,603 + excess 3,106,922, p4); it equals the sum of receipts items. Beginning cash 18,898,840 is the printed beginning fund balance/net position (all assets are cash, p4) and ending cash 23,375,992 total assets (p5). Transfers (General 233,901 out, Other governmental funds in) net to zero in the total column, so transfers_in/out are null. Balance sheet from the net position section (p3); no liabilities printed (fund statement shows -0-). The 'Education Agency' pass-through fund's disbursements are eliminated in the Reclassifications column. Detail: General Fund budget schedule (pp6-10) lists program codes without object detail, so spending is 'not itemized'; GF column of governmental funds also includes the Depreciation and Employee Benefit funds (separate schedules pp12-13). Federal programs and categorical program disbursements categorized as instruction (dominant). GF function totals by code differ somewhat from Statement of Activities function lines (e.g. operation of plant 3,495,850 by code vs 3,445,850), but GF total ties (27,208,616 + 233,901 transfers = 27,442,517). Budget amounts only given as totals, so budget_final is null for most line items. Depreciation fund 'Transfer - General Fund' 95,011 and 'other nonrevenue receipts' treated as other financing within that schedule. Read pages 1-20 of 20
